reviews.review:
What a frustratin experience.

Do you like spending 2minutes and half your ammo trying to kill a single static ennemy? Oh, that ennemy is door by the way.

Do you like grinding the same levele again, and again, and again, and again to eventually have enough money to buy enough ammo to fight a boss for 5min straight?

Do you like to play a doge game with death laser beam? Did I mention that this game sometimes involve dodiging both a high and low beam? Which is impossible and will get you instantly killed.

Personally, my answer to all these questions is no.
